publisher: Tennessee Department of Human Services / State of Tennessee STS GIS
ownership: Official STS GIS distribution of DHS-derived childcare location evidence.
allowed_use: fixed public HTTPS metadata, terms, center-filtered count, ID inventory and selected-field queries
immutable internal selected source retention with complete publisher XML bytes and JSON terms
local-review normalization preserving source status, attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: retrieving family homes, group homes, drop-in centers or authorized-provider records under this center-only scope
requesting unselected contact, owner, telephone, email or private record fields
inferring current operation, license validity dates, ownership, parents or unique-business identity from source inclusion
claiming TDOE or nationwide childcare completeness from this DHS-only selected extract
inferring closure from disappearance or treating modification dates as observation or license dates
redistribution without a separate export decision
attribution: Tennessee Department of Human Services; State of Tennessee STS GIS
publisher_notice_requirement: Retain complete item terms, including user-assumed risk and hold-harmless conditions, and publisher XML unchanged. No legal determination or new agreement acceptance is authorized by this policy. Authorized downstream use must preserve applicable notices and attribution.
coordinate_handling: Retain explicitly requested WGS84 point evidence; normalized entities contain latitude/longitude only. Coordinate plausibility is not boundary verification or geocoding accuracy approval.
retention: Immutable local source evidence; operator-governed deletion. No automatic retention cleanup is implemented.
redistribution: Not authorized by this implementation; local-review-only.
personal_data_handling: Business names and premises can identify people; exclude residential provider categories and unselected contacts before retrieval. Keep selected raw evidence internal and normalized records local-review-only.

evidence.basis: Bounded official source validation and verified metadata-preflight receipt; each acquisition must independently retain and validate its source evidence.
evidence.limitations: Source Active is publisher extract status, not independently verified operation. TDOE and other care types are outside scope. No source-native license expiry, cross-release identity stability, current USPS validity or nationwide denominator is established.
